supporting_quotes.exact:
The ISA is the interface between what the software commands 
and what the hardware carries out

the attributes of a 
system as seen by the programmer, i.e., the conceptual 
structure and functional behavior as distinct from the 
organization of the dataflow and controls, the logic design, 
and the physical implementation

observations.subject: ISA-visible system attributes
observations.object: dataflow/control organization, logic design, and physical implementation

claims.rationale: 第一条引文直接支持 ISA 是软件命令与硬件执行之间的接口。第二条支持程序员可见的概念结构和功能行为区别于数据流与控制组织、逻辑设计及物理实现；但引文未明确列出“指令与状态”，因此该扩展表述仅获部分支持。

supporting_quotes.exact:
Microarchitecture: How the underlying implementation 
actually executes instructions

Microarchitecture can execute instructions in any order as long 
as it obeys the semantics specified by the ISA when making the 
instruction results visible to software

qualifiers.constraint: must obey ISA semantics when results become visible to software

claims.rationale: 两条引文一致支持微架构负责实际执行指令，并可按任意顺序执行，只要在向软件呈现结果时遵守 ISA 语义。

supporting_quotes.exact: There can be many implementations of the same ISA

claims.rationale: 引文直接支持同一 ISA 可以有多个实现；但未明确说明这些实现的性能和内部组织不必相同，因此该附加断言未被引文直接支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: RISC uses a small set of simple, fixed-length instructions and follows a load/store approach, enabling efficient and fast execution.
CISC uses a larger set of complex, variable-length instructions that can perform multiple operations, often requiring multiple clock cycles.

observations.subject: RISC
observations.object: simple fixed-length instructions and load/store approach

observations.subject: CISC
observations.object: complex variable-length instructions with multiple operations

claims.rationale: 两条引文分别支持 RISC 的简单固定长度指令和 load/store 方式，以及 CISC 的复杂变长指令和多操作特征；但引文未支持“这些是设计倾向而非硬性定义”这一限定。

supporting_quotes.exact: This document describes PTX, a low-level parallel thread execution virtual machine and instruction set architecture (ISA). PTX exposes the GPU as a data-parallel computing device.
PTX programs are translated at install time to the target hardware instruction set.

observations.subject: PTX
observations.object: a GPU-oriented virtual machine and ISA

claims.rationale: 第一条引文明确将 PTX 定义为并行线程执行虚拟机和 ISA，并将 GPU 暴露为数据并行设备；第二条明确支持 PTX 程序被翻译为目标硬件指令集。

supporting_quotes.exact: AArch64 state supports a single instruction set, called A64. This is a fixed-length instruction set that uses 32-bit instruction encodings.

observations.subject: AArch64 state
observations.object: A64 fixed-length instruction set with 32-bit encodings

claims.rationale: 引文明确说明 AArch64 状态使用称为 A64 的单一指令集，该指令集为固定长度并使用 32 位指令编码。

supporting_quotes.exact: A 64-bit general-purpose register named X0 to X30.
A 32-bit general-purpose register named W0 to W30.
A 64-bit Program Counter holding the address of the current instruction.

claims.rationale: 前三条引文支持 31 个通用寄存器及其 X0-X30、W0-W30 访问名称；后两条支持 SP 为专用寄存器、PC 保存当前指令地址。引文未直接陈述“SP 与 PC 不计作第 32、33 个通用寄存器”，因此该排除性结论仅获部分支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: In the Arm memory model, the Shareability memory attribute indicates the degree to which hardware must ensure memory coherency between a set of observers.

observations.subject: Shareability memory attribute
observations.object: degree of memory coherency hardware must ensure between observers

claims.rationale: 引文直接说明 Arm 内存模型中的 Shareability 属性表示硬件必须在一组观察者之间确保的内存一致性程度。

missing_evidence: isa-definition: 引文未直接列出程序可见的指令与状态。
same-isa-implementations: 引文未直接支持不同实现的性能和内部组织不必相同。
risc-cisc-tendencies: 引文未直接支持“设计倾向而非硬性定义”。
arm-aarch64-registers: 引文未直接说明 SP 与 PC 不计作第 32、33 个通用寄存器。
